name: SolarBalls
description: What if we could see the universe from a different perspective? If we were not constrained to Earth's gravity, and we could just fly across space and see the planets from up-close? Well... we'd probably freak out after we notice they have a face!

videos.title: The Big Bang
videos.overview: How was the universe formed? What is the origin of everything we know? How was our solar system born? A father shares this story with his son over the course of three consecutive nights.

videos.title: Space is SO Normal
videos.overview: Astrodude's lonely mission to space turned out livelier than he expected, as he discovers that planets can talk... somehow.

videos.title: Let's Terraform Mars!
videos.overview: During Astrodude's stay at the Mars base, he lived many crazy adventures. This is one of them!

videos.title: The Gas Giants
videos.overview: Astrodude discovers first hand that the Solar System extends much beyond Mars, across gas giants and even moons that are bigger than planets.

videos.title: The Moons of Jupiter
videos.overview: The Solar System is more complicated than once thought, as both planets and moons start new friendships and break old ones.

videos.title: Earth Alone
videos.overview: The Earth is now completely alone! Can it still sustain life? Will the Earthlings survive long enough?

videos.title: Planets vs Moons
videos.overview: Venus and Mars meet Ganymede and Europa. The choices made in this encounter will change the destiny of the Solar System forever!

videos.title: The Moon Army
videos.overview: The moons are plotting something. But are they too small for the planets to notice before something happens?

videos.title: The Dwarf Planets
videos.overview: Once thought to be a planet, Pluto now struggles with finding his new place in a changing Solar System.

videos.title: The Moon Revolution
videos.overview: The Moon Revolution is finally here! The Moons will gather at the asteroid belt and plan their next big move against the planets! Who will come on top?

videos.title: Our Weird Planet
videos.overview: Where has Astrodude been all this time? Well, surrounded by the most ALIEN creatures in our Solar System!

videos.title: The Moons Return
videos.overview: Where is Jupiter? Where has he gone? The biggest planet of the solar system is suddenly missing, but where could he be?

videos.title: Planets Ordered by Size
videos.overview: The Sun has a crazy idea: what if the planets were ordered by size? The answer? Pure Chaos!

videos.title: The Moon Club
videos.overview: After the revolution, the moons begin to reorganize in preparation for what's coming next.

videos.title: Solar System Trials
videos.overview: Planets on one side, moons on the other… all must face judgment before the Sun. Who will suffer the consequences of its ruthless verdict?

videos.title: Search for Planet X
videos.overview: A mystery from the past, a legend forgotten for millions of years. Does the ninth planet of our solar system truly exist?

videos.title: Planet X Return
videos.overview: A forgotten secret, a hidden betrayal that has waited millions of years is about to be revealed. Who does it implicate? Who will take responsibility and face the consequences?

videos.title: What if we replaced Jupiter
videos.overview: The Sun has made a difficult decision, but the question now is: can the Solar System survive without the gas giant?

videos.title: The Battle of Planet X
videos.overview: The final battle. The Sun proposes three of his outrageous games, where Planet X must face off against the moons. An epic showdown to determine who wins the dispute.

videos.title: Surviving the Dark Side of the Moon
videos.overview: On the dark side of the Moon, Astrodude and a forgotten Russian cosmonaut compete for a secret that could change the course of human history. But they're not alone-an enigmatic robot watches them while carrying out an intricate plan.

videos.title: Jupiter is BACK!
videos.overview: The giant has returned, and must try to restore order in the Solar System. But just as everything seems to be settling down, Earth begins to be haunted by a memory it thought was long forgotten.

videos.title: The Earth is LEAVING
videos.overview: Earth delves deeper and deeper into memories of his past, tormented by a cryptic recollection that hides a monumental event.

videos.title: Solar System is EMPTY!
videos.overview: Everyone is gone-except for Mercury and Venus. But the Sun has big plans for this troublesome duo.

videos.title: Lost Earth
videos.overview: What lies behind the mystery that torments Earth? What great secret is about to be revealed? Can Earth come to its senses and save humanity from an impending apocalypse?

videos.title: The Big Bang - Part 1
videos.overview: This is where it all began.

videos.title: The Big Bang - Part 2
videos.overview: A father recounts how Jupiter seizes a moment when the Sun is distracted to change orbits, causing a catastrophic collision that destroys several rocky planets—an event called the Grand Tack that would reshape our solar system.

How Do Planets Develop Life? - Part 3

Veritasium becomes a Space Explorer!
videos.overview: Astrodude and @veritasium are fighting to be chosen for ROTSAR's secret mission and become space explorers! Who Will be chosen?

videos.title: "Space is normal" they said...
videos.overview: Astrodude's adventures in space begin. What awaits him outside the comforts of his planet? Well... spoiler alert, some weird stuff...

videos.title: What REALLY is a planet? (feat. Steve Taylor)
videos.overview: After Astrodude arrives to space, he's spooked by the fact that planets talk. So now he has to talk to Steve Taylor to figure out what really IS a planet?

videos.title: The closest planet to every other planet is...
videos.overview: Welcome to the new Sun competition, where the Sun rewards the planets that stand out in... anything! Today, we'll find out who the closest planet to every other planet is!

videos.title: Something's hiding in the Asteroid Belt...
videos.overview: What is hiding in the Asteroid Belt? Looks like a planet of sorts...

videos.title: What if the Sun disappeared?
videos.overview: The Sun decides he has had enough and tells everyone he is going to leave.

videos.title: What if Planets Collide?
videos.overview: The Earth wants to play tag and almost crashes into Mars… thus, nearly causing the end of the world. What would really happen if two planets collide?

videos.title: My Best Friend, the Sun!
videos.overview: Mercury and the Sun have a chat with each other.

videos.title: Can planets SHARE an orbit?
videos.overview: Mercury has had enough of the sun's solar flares, so he goes to Venus to share his orbit. But is this such a good idea?

videos.title: Pluto is a Planet again...?
videos.overview: Pluto is invited back into the "planets" gang! Why was he kicked out in the first place?

videos.title: Is the Moon REALLY leaving us?
videos.overview: The Earth starts to brag about his Moon being WAY better than everyone else's. However, he soon realizes that the Moon MAY not stay with him forever.

videos.title: What if the moon went away?
videos.overview: The Earth's Moon is tired of feeling worthless, so he decides to leave for good. But what effects will this have on the Earthlings?

videos.title: How the Moon Landing changed EVERYTHING?
videos.overview: After messing up with the Earth, the Moon goes to Astrodude and jokes about it, but Astrodude goes on a tangent about how the Moon inspired him during his youth.

videos.title: Is Mercury NOT a Planet?
videos.overview: Venus questions if Mercury is even a planet, which gives Mercury kind of an existential crisis.

videos.title: Will Mercury explode?
videos.overview: Mercury has been twisting and crashing lately. Is he about to explode?

videos.title: The Secret of Venus
videos.overview: Venus is trying to hide the meaning of his name from everyone else. Why's that?

videos.title: Surviving Venus - Part 1
videos.overview: Astrodude ends up stranded in Venus, one of the deadliest planets in our Solar System. To survive, he'll have to think outside of the box... as he's dealing with acid rain and boiling hot temperatures.

videos.title: Surviving Venus - Part 2
videos.overview: After being left stranded on Venus, Astrodude must find a way to escape this terrible planet before the heat or, well, the Venera robots claim his life!

videos.title: Venus wants a makeover!
videos.overview: Venus is now being mocked for being named after the "Goddess of Love and Beauty", so he'll try to become just that: beautiful!

videos.title: Why is there ONLY life on Earth?
videos.overview: Venus, Mars, and Mercury have a discussion about Earth, and why it's the only planet in the Solar System that can support life.

videos.title: The Space Trash Problem
videos.overview: The Earth has been having a hard time trying to deal with his earthlings, who keep contaminating not only the planet, but the atmosphere and beyond.

videos.title: Sorry, Earth...
videos.overview: The Earth is extremely dirty! He not only have contaminated it's surface, but also we left a lot of space trash around the orbit. Astrodude sheds some light as to why that is.

videos.title: Can the Earth have rings of TRASH!?
videos.overview: The Earth shows off his rings to Venus and Mercury, but it's made of trash!?

videos.title: Why do we want to live on Mars?
videos.overview: Just as Astrodude arrives on Mars, the Earth and Mars discuss what's up with the Earthling's obsession with the red planet.

videos.title: Can we survive on Mars?
videos.overview: Astrodude attempts to survive on Mars without a suit.

videos.title: Will Robots conquer Space?
videos.overview: After Astrodude is left for dead on Mars, a robot is sent to save his life. However, this robot will slowly gain consciousness and realize he can technically conquer space before humans can.

videos.overview: After surviving thanks to the mysterious robot SAR, Astrodude goes into Mars' orbit to discuss with his wife how space changes your body.

videos.title: Is there sound on Mars?
videos.overview: A special date is approaching, so Astrodude comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Meet Neptune
videos.overview: Neptune joins the party! He's like... a bit weird.

videos.title: Uranus = Neptune?
videos.overview: Turns out Uranus and Neptune are quite similar.

videos.title: The Secret of Uranus
videos.overview: Name says it all.

videos.title: The Adventures Of Uranus And Saturn
videos.overview: Neptune is missing! And it's up to the ringed planets to find him.

videos.title: Who's THAT planet!?
videos.overview: In their journey to find Neptune, Uranus and Saturn find a... strange planet they've never seen before.

videos.title: Why is Neptune MISSING!?
videos.overview: Neptune is usually gone, and Uranus and Saturn want to know why that is or where exactly does he go. The answer is... kinda obvious, really. But also sad.

videos.overview: What if space became Lego? What would the planets be like? Would anything make sense anymore?

videos.title: Why does Saturn have rings?
videos.overview: Neptune wants to know why Saturn has rings... but he asks Uranus about it, making him jealous.

videos.title: The Moons of Saturn

videos.overview: Titan has a strange fixation on the Earth and the Moon, so he crosses the Asteroid Belt to meet them.

videos.title: My Best Friend, the Earth!

videos.title: Venus ALMOST had life!?

videos.title: Search for Planet X - Part 2
videos.overview: Following their exile, Ganymede and Europa go beyond the Kuiper Belt to find the mysterious Planet X. Meanwhile, the other moons gather to tell the Sun to bring Ganymede and Europa back.

videos.title: Search for Planet X - Part 3
videos.overview: The journey of the exiled moons continues through the icy depths of the Solar System. Their search for the mysterious Planet X brings them face-to-face with forgotten worlds and dark secrets about Jupiter's past.

videos.title: Planet X Returns! - Part 1
videos.overview: Planet X tells a story about Jupiter's Grand Tack to Ganymede and Europa, and they were bewildered by it. Meanwhile, Jupiter threatens the Sun that he'll leave if he doesn't bring Ganymede and Europa back.

videos.title: Planet X Returns! - Part 2
videos.overview: Planet X gets closer to the Sun.

videos.title: Planet X Returns! - Part 3
